brief:
Four countries—Australia, Canada, Italy and the UK—have called on Israel to allow tents and supplies into Gaza, accusing it of blocking aid deliveries amid an ongoing humanitarian crisis, Al Jazeera English reported.

The nations did not specify when they made the appeal or through what diplomatic channels. The move adds to mounting pressure from Western allies on Israel over humanitarian access to Gaza.
dek: The countries accuse Israel of preventing tents and other supplies from entering Gaza, despite the humanitarian crisis.
title: Four Western nations urge Israel to open Gaza to humanitarian aid
